latest.headline: How the King chose his own look for Tu Mil Jaaye, now No. 2 on Gaana's Hindi chart
latest.deck: Choreographers Shazia Samji and Piyush Bhagat told Mid-Day that Shah Rukh Khan wanted an age-appropriate presentation in Tu Mil Jaaye, so they sat him in a car for Ed Sheeran's rap; the song was shot over a week in May in Cape Town. It is No. 2 on Gaana's Hindi True Fan Chart for 2-8 Nov (Mirchi Plus) and read 76,852,499 YouTube views on 13 Nov at 07:03 IST.
latest.quote: You have to earn this song.
latest.quote_by: Siddharth Anand to the choreographers, as Piyush Bhagat told Mid-Day
